name: Conformance: Approval (reject loops back)
description: openwop#1697. A rejected approval gate routed over an any_failed edge to revise, which loops back to the gate (bounded by settings.maxLoopbackIterations 2). Rejected once, the gate is visited again: the host MUST raise a new interrupt.requested with a different key and wait for a new decision, never replaying the first rejection. Conformance scenario: v2-approval-reject-disposition.test.ts.
